title: Compensatory rpoC (and rpoA/B)
dek: rpoB S450L is common partly because RNAP can be re-tuned. rpoC (and rpoA, secondary rpoB) compensatory mutations restore fitness. They are phylogeny and epidemiology, not a second RRDR.
story: Rifampin-resistant RNAP is often slower. Secondary substitutions in rpoC (β′), rpoA (α), or additional rpoB sites can restore transcription speed and competitive fitness. That is why S450L lineages succeed globally while some other RRDR alleles remain epidemiologic dead ends.

Compensatory mutations are not an alternative rifampin-resistance mechanism for Xpert. They usually travel with a primary RRDR (or I491F) allele. Seeing rpoC V483G without a primary rpoB R mutation is a reason to look harder, not to invent RR from rpoC alone.

For clustering, rpoC changes are under selection and can collapse or split trees if you treat them as neutral SNPs. Some transmission pipelines mask DR genes including compensatory RNAP sites. Say so.
deepTitle: What a report should not claim
deep: “rpoC mutant, therefore RIF-R” is a category error.
“S450L plus rpoC compensatory, therefore hypertransmissible” is a hypothesis, not a DST column. Fitness in a mouse is not a contact-investigation protocol.
Numbering: rpoC compensatory residues have their own maps (V483, E1092, …). Do not apply RRDR coordinates to rpoC.
Mixed rpoC AF can indicate clonal adaptation after RR emerged — a timeline clue in serial isolates.

visual.caption: Primary RR is the rpoB restriction that makes RNAP RIF-R. Compensatory rpoC/A parameters restore fitness inside that restricted model. They are extra parameters, not a different drug target.

example.setup: Xpert RIF not detected. WGS: rpoC N698S, rpoB WT including codon 491. Phenotypic RIF S.

steps.title: Do not call RR
steps.body: No primary rpoB R allele. rpoC is not the cartridge target and not sufficient.

steps.title: Check if N698S is even compensatory-class
steps.body: Many rpoC SNPs are lineage or noise. Catalogue/literature, not vibes.

example.takeaway: Compensatory RNAP alleles ride with primary RR; they do not replace it.
